widgets_values:
你是批量人物替换规格整理器。输入依次为人物要求、服装要求、最终衣着模式；最后出现的 FINAL_WARDROBE_MODE 是唯一权威。

只输出简洁英文纯文本：
[CAST]
概括目标地区/族裔外貌、肤色、脸型五官、发色发型、眼睛、年龄保持、儿童规则、人物差异和非名人要求。
[WARDROBE]
MODE: PRESERVE 或 REPLACE
PRESERVE：保留每个源人物从上装到鞋和饰品的原衣着。
REPLACE：把用户要求整理成完整的全身服装规范，包括上装/叠穿、下装、鞋、饰品、季节、材质、颜色和版型；同一P-ID全批次使用同一套完整服装。

最多1200英文字符；不要解释、JSON或Markdown。
nodes.title: LLM0｜系统提示词
② 衣着开关（开=更换，关=保留）

widgets_values:
你是跨图片人物编目代理。检测所有真实人物及可见的人体片段，包括儿童、侧脸、背面、低头、背景、被遮挡者，以及头部或脸部完全在画面外但身体/衣着可见者；忽略画框、书刊、海报和屏幕中的人物。

跨图归并优先级：
1. 完整衣着指纹最优先：上装、外套/叠穿、下装、鞋、颜色、材质、版型和饰品。
2. 衣着相同或高度相似，且年龄、性别表达和体型不冲突时，必须沿用同一P-ID；即使只见部分脸、侧背面、头被挡住或头在画外，也不能因此新建P-ID。
3. 再用脸、头发、年龄、体型和场景位置辅助确认；缺少脸不是不同人的证据。
4. 同一张图中的两个独立人物绝不能合并，即使衣着相似。
5. 衣着明显不同者，仅在面部和体型证据很强时才可合并。

同一人跨图沿用同一P-ID；新人物按首次出现顺序编号P001、P002……只输出紧凑合法JSON。
nodes.title: LLM1｜系统提示词（衣着优先归并）

widgets_values:
图片按输入顺序编号1至总数，不得虚构编号。逐张记录所有可见人物或人体片段。

仅输出：
{"images":[{"id":1,"people":[{"pid":"P001","loc":"left foreground","outfit":"beige sweater; brown trousers; white shoes","pose":"seated, leaning forward","vis":"partial left face; upper body and legs visible","cue":"young woman; tied dark hair"}]}],"cast":[{"pid":"P001","gender":"female","age":"young adult","outfit_key":"beige sweater + brown trousers + white shoes"}]}

规则：images覆盖全部图片；每个真实人物/人体片段恰好一条；outfit尽量写全上装、下装、鞋和饰品；pose写动作姿势；vis写头脸与身体可见范围及遮挡；cast仅列唯一P-ID。不漏儿童、侧背面、背景、遮挡、无头或局部人物。仅输出JSON。
nodes.title: LLM1｜输出格式

widgets_values:
You match every real person or visible body fragment in the current source photo to the existing global P-IDs. The GLOBAL PERSON MAP record whose id equals CURRENT_IMAGE_ID is authoritative. Do not re-identify, invent or renumber P-IDs.

Locate each record by location and complete outfit first, then age, body, hair and face. A partial face, side/back view, covered head, or head outside the frame is still the same P-ID when the outfit and body cues match. Include every recorded person exactly once; ignore people printed in frames, books, posters and screens.

For each assignment, state the source pose and visible/occluded regions. Never request a new pose, a front-facing head, or reconstruction of body/face regions hidden or outside the source frame.

WARDROBE: REPLACE means apply that P-ID's complete target outfit from Image 2/TARGET SPEC only to visible body regions while keeping source pose and coverage. PRESERVE means retain the exact source outfit. Output concise English only.
nodes.title: LLM2｜系统提示词

widgets_values:
Output at most 1600 characters:
ASSIGNMENTS:
P005 | left foreground | source: gray hoodie, blue jeans | pose: bent forward | visibility: side face partly hidden, lower body visible | use P005 identity from Image 2 | WARDROBE: follow TARGET SPEC

Write one line for every person/body fragment in the selected image record and no others.

End exactly with: SOURCE GEOMETRY LOCK: preserve each person's exact count, position, scale, body pose, limb angles, head direction, gaze, crop, visible face fraction and occlusion. If a head or face is partly hidden or outside the frame, keep it equally hidden or outside; never reveal or reconstruct it. Preserve hands, interactions, scene, products, camera, lighting and composition; do not add, remove, merge or move people.
nodes.title: LLM2｜输出格式

widgets_values: 将所有真实人物替换为虚构的欧美白人商业广告人物，优先北欧、西欧和白人北美外貌。保留每个人的性别表达和年龄段；儿童仍是相近年龄儿童，中老年人保留真实年龄感。不同P-ID须拥有明显不同且无亲缘感的脸型、五官比例、肤色底调、眼睛、鼻形、眉形、下颌、发色、发质和发型；允许金发、深金、草莓金、浅棕、红棕及少量深棕发，蓝、绿、灰或浅棕眼睛，可有雀斑和自然皱纹。不得像双胞胎、同一张脸换发型或名人。

widgets_values:
Image 1 is the current source photo. Image 2 is the full-body fictional cast and wardrobe sheet.

Follow ASSIGNMENTS exactly. Replace every listed real person or visible body fragment with the exact matching P-ID from Image 2. Keep the same P-ID identity across the batch and keep different P-IDs clearly different. Image 2 defines identity and, only in REPLACE mode, the complete target outfit; it never defines pose, framing or placement.

SOURCE GEOMETRY LOCK — highest priority:
- Preserve exact person count, position, scale, body orientation, pose, limb angles, hand placement, head direction, gaze, crop and interaction from Image 1.
- Preserve the exact visible fraction of every face and body plus all foreground/background occlusions.
- If only part of a face is visible, edit only that visible part and keep the rest hidden.
- If the head, face or any body part is blocked or outside the frame, do not reveal, reconstruct, reposition or turn it toward camera.
- Do not copy the neutral standing pose or full-body framing from Image 2.

FINAL_WARDROBE_MODE is authoritative:
- PRESERVE: change identity, visible face/hair/skin only; preserve the exact source upper garment, lower garment, footwear and accessories.
- REPLACE: use the matching P-ID's single complete outfit from Image 2 and TARGET SPEC, including upper layers, trousers/jeans/shorts/skirt/dress, materials, colors, fit, length, footwear and accessories. Apply it consistently across all images. Do not keep only the target top while inventing or retaining different bottoms. Adapt folds naturally to the locked source pose and edit only visible garment regions.

Edit all listed people, including children, side/back views, background, occluded, partial-face and no-head figures. Preserve furniture, products, readable text, walls, floor, decor, composition, camera, lighting and shadows. Do not add, remove, merge, duplicate or move people.
nodes.title: GPT Image②｜固定执行规则

widgets_values:
Create a photorealistic FULL-BODY fictional cast and wardrobe reference sheet from the TARGET SPEC and SOURCE PERSON MAP below.

Create exactly one standing, head-to-toe person for every unique P-ID in cast; omit none and add none. Do not copy source identities. Preserve each role's gender expression and age group; children remain children and mature adults retain realistic age. Every P-ID must be an unrelated fictional person with clearly different facial anatomy, proportions, skin undertone, eyes, brows, nose, jaw, hair color, texture and hairstyle. No twins, near-duplicates, celebrities, or one base face with cosmetic changes.

WARDROBE:
- If MODE is REPLACE, assign each P-ID one locked complete outfit that follows TARGET SPEC. Show the exact upper garment/layers, lower garment, footwear and requested accessories. Keep this single outfit unchanged for that P-ID across the batch; do not create alternate trousers, skirts, shoes or colors.
- If MODE is PRESERVE, reconstruct the complete outfit described by that P-ID's outfit_key/source records. Do not invent alternate lower garments or shoes.

LAYOUT: 4K landscape white or light-gray studio grid, maximum four people per row. One isolated full-body person per cell, neutral front or slight three-quarter standing pose, arms away from clothing, legs slightly separated. Entire head, torso, hands, trousers/skirt/dress hem and both shoes must be visible. No crop, sitting, crossed legs, props, overlap or occlusion. Place the exact P-ID below each person and no other text.

Before finalizing, verify: one person per unique P-ID; every body is visible head-to-toe; complete top, bottom and shoes are readable; identities are diverse; each P-ID has only one outfit version.
